title: English Test 1
description: English Test 1 — Vocabulary and Grammar (100 MCQs, 1 mark each, no negative marking). Select the single best answer (A–E) for each question; for Error Detection items, identify the underlined segment (A–D) containing the error, or select E for no error. American English conventions throughout. The exam also includes two hand-graded essays (15 marks each) that are not part of this online test.
